powers.title: Bloodthirsty Resurgence
powers.description: When you call upon your hidden reserves, you evoke the same new will in your allies.
rows: Trigger: You spend a healing surge
Target: Each ally in the burst that can see you
Effect: The target gains temporary hit points equal to your Charisma.

powers.title: Bounding Stride
powers.description: You lope across the battlefield, your wounds fueling your stride.
rows: Effect: You move your speed + 2, or your speed + 6 if you are bloodied.

powers.title: Combat Sprint
powers.description: Having saved a bit of strength for just this moment, you burst across the battlefield.
rows: Effect: You move your speed + 4. You gain a +4 bonus to all defenses against any opportunity attack you provoke with this movement.

powers.title: Feral Rejuvenation
powers.description: You call on the spirits to stitch your wounds, proudly displaying the blood you have spilled in their names.
rows: Trigger: Your attack damages an enemy
Effect: You spend a healing surge. If the triggering attack reduced an enemy to 0 hit points, you regain additional hit points equal to one-half your level + your Charisma.

powers.title: Ignore Pain
powers.description: When your enemies hurt you, the strength of your rage allows you to shove the pain aside for a time.
rows: Trigger: You take damage.
Effect: You gain temporary hit points equal to the triggering damage.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Feywild, page(s) 47.

powers.title: Nomad's Rush
powers.description: Your training allows you to spot rough terrain with ease—and dash over it without a second thought.
rows: Effect: You move up to your speed + 4. During this move, you ignore difficult terrain.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Feywild, page(s) 47.

powers.title: Primal Vitality
powers.description: Drawing strength from the ground beneath your feet, you push away the pain of minor wounds.
rows: Effect: You gain temporary hit points equal to one-half your level + your Constitution. If you are raging, the number of temporary hit points you gain equals one-half your level + twice your Constitution.

powers.title: Savage Comeback
powers.description: An enemy tried to hinder you, but you break free, ignoring the injury you suffer in the process.
rows: Trigger: You are conscious and fail a saving throw
Effect: You take 2d6 damage and succeed on the saving throw.

powers.title: Savage Growl
powers.description: If the blow you just delivered wasn't enough to get your foe's attention, your menacing growl cannot be ignored.
rows: Trigger: You hit an enemy and don't reduce it to 0 hit points
Target: The enemy you hit
Effect: You mark the target until the end of your next turn. Until the mark ends, you and the target deal 1d8 extra damage against each other.

powers.title: Shrug It Off
powers.description: With a brutal shake of your head, you slough off a hindrance before it can affect you.
rows: Trigger: You are subjected to an effect that a save can end
Effect: You make a saving throw against the triggering effect. If you succeed, you shift 1 square as a free action.

powers.title: Stonebreaker
powers.description: Without hesitation, you smash through the door.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +5 bonus to Strength checks to break objects, and you deal double damage against objects.

powers.title: Tiger's Leap
powers.description: With a surge of strength and will, you leap a great distance without a running start.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Athletics.
Effect: You make an Athletics check to jump with a +5 power bonus. You are considered to have a running start and can move as far as the check allows.

powers.title: Climber's Claws
powers.description: Thick claws spring from your hands, allowing you to scale surfaces quickly.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a climb speed equal to your speed.

powers.title: Combat Surge
powers.description: As your attack goes awry, you react from the heat of your rage, without pause or thought, reversing your weapon and striking again.
rows: Trigger: You miss with an attack
Requirement: You must be raging.
Effect: You reroll the attack.

powers.title: Cull Weakness
powers.description: Only the strong survive, and you let your enemies know that you are a survivor as you strike down the weakest among them with ease. The others quail before you as their wounds mount.
rows: Effect: You assume the cull weakness stance. Until the stance ends, bloodied enemies grant combat advantage to you, and you gain a +4 power bonus to damage rolls against them.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Feywild, page(s) 48.

powers.title: Indomitable Shift
powers.description: You pound across the battlefield, leaving no opening as you move and drawing strength from the numbers arrayed against you.
rows: Effect: You shift a number of squares equal to your Constitution. You gain 1d10 temporary hit points plus 1 additional temporary hit point for each enemy within 2 squares of you.

powers.title: Instinctive Charge
powers.description: Instinctively aware of danger, you are poised to fight as soon as the battle begins.
rows: Trigger: You roll initiative at the beginning of an encounter
Effect: You gain a +5 power bonus to your initiative. You also gain a +2 power bonus to your first attack roll during the encounter.

powers.title: Laugh it Off
powers.description: You laugh at your foe's attack, making even its mightiest effort seem pointless against your boundless endurance.
rows: Trigger: You are hit by an enemy's attack.

Effect: Reduce the triggering attack's damage by an amount equal to your Constitution. You gain a +2 power bonus to your next attack roll and damage roll against the triggering enemy made before the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Loss of Will
powers.description: As you turn aside your foe's attack, you stare into its eyes. Your enemy now knows that the battle is in your favor.
rows: Trigger: An enemy misses you with you an attack
Target: The triggering enemy
Effect: Until the end of the target's next turn, the target takes a penalty to attack rolls against you equal to your Charisma.

powers.title: Primal Charge
powers.description: You thunder across the battlefield in a blur of steel and speed.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +4 power bonus to speed when charging.

powers.title: Relentless Surge
powers.description: With a deep breath, you draw vigor from within yourself.
rows: Effect: You gain 5 + your Constitution temporary hit points.

powers.title: Run Rampant
powers.description: With bestial might, you break free and step forward, eager for battle again.
rows: Effect: You make either an escape attempt or a saving throw against an effect that immobilizes, restrains, or slows you. You gain a bonus to the roll equal to your Strength.

powers.title: Snarling Defiance
powers.description: Your blood flows, and your response is a feral snarl as you prepare to make the offender pay.
rows: Trigger: You are hit and damaged by an attack
Effect: You take half damage from the attack and gain a +2 power bonus to attack rolls against the attacker until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Wilderness Step
powers.description: Your skill in traversing the wilderness allows you to bypass hindering effects that would delay others.
rows: Trigger: You start your turn subject to an immobilized, restrained, or slowed condition that a save can end.
Effect: You make a saving throw with a +2 power bonus against one triggering condition.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Feywild, page(s) 48.

powers.title: Barbaric Instinct
powers.description: Submerging conscious thought, you cut through the fog that threatens to envelop your mind.
rows: Trigger: You are subjected to a dazing or a stunning effect
Effect: If the effect would have dazed you, you aren't dazed. If the effect would have stunned you, you are dazed instead.

powers.title: Barbaric Offering
powers.description: You ruin your foe, and the spirit of triumph steels you against a hindrance.
rows: Trigger: You bloody an enemy or reduce it to 0 hit points
Effect: You make a saving throw against one effect that a save can end, with a bonus equal to your Charisma (minimum +1).

powers.title: Deny Death
powers.description: The darkness will not swallow you until you have finished what you set out to do.
rows: Trigger: You drop to 0 hit points or fewer and don't die
Effect: You are dying but don't fall unconscious because of that condition. At the end of your next turn, you fall unconscious if you are still dying.

powers.title: Enraged Surge
powers.description: Your errant blow fuels your anger, empowering your strikes for a few moments.
rows: Trigger: You miss with an attack while raging
Effect: You gain a +2 power bonus to melee attack rolls and melee damage rolls until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Heart Strike
powers.description: You put the weight of your spirit behind every swing of your weapon.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, whenever you hit with an at-will attack power, the attack deals extra damage equal to your Charisma.

powers.title: Howl of the Alpha Wolf
powers.description: You snarl nearly incomprehensible orders to your allies, and they hasten to obey.
rows: Target: One ally in the burst, or each ally in the burst if you have reduced an enemy to 0 hit points during this turn
Effect: You slide each target 2 squares. You then shift 3 squares.

powers.title: Mountain Roots
powers.description: You sink your spirit into the earth to stand your ground.
rows: Trigger: You are pulled, pushed, or slid
Effect: You negate the forced movement. Until the stance ends, you can negate forced movement against you.

powers.title: Surge of Fury
powers.description: You release a howl that blocks out the whispers of your enemies and fills you with a fury that gives you a clarity of purpose.
rows: Trigger: You start your turn subject to a dazing or dominating effect.
Effect: You end the triggering effect. Until the end of your next turn you are immune to effects that daze or dominate you.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Feywild, page(s) 49.

powers.title: Totemic Scarification
powers.description: As you set aside caution for relentlessness, glowing totemic symbols begin carving themselves across your skin.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, you take a –2 penalty to all defenses but gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls.

powers.title: Wellspring of Renewal
powers.description: You draw on a fount of primal energy to renew your strength and your focus.
rows: Effect: You gain temporary hit points equal to one-half your level + your Constitution. In addition, if you are marked, that condition ends.
